subject: English
question_text: Fill in each gap with suitable words based on the information of the text. 1 5 =
stimulus: On 21 February, people remember the martyrs of the language movement by walking barefoot to the Shaheed Minar. They wear black badges and sing (a) ------- songs. Wreaths are placed at the monument to show (b) ------- to those who died for Bangla. In 1999, UNESCO declared 21 February as International Mother Language Day. This recognition was given to honour the (c) ------- of our language heroes. The day is now observed worldwide to promote (d) ------- and the importance of (e) ------- rights. ■■■ ■■■
guide_solution: Ans. (a) mourning; (b) respect; (c) sacrifice; (d) diversity; (e) language;
